title: ipgeo Configuration
description: Configuration file for ipgeo — the IP geolocation CLI tool. Place this file at $IPGEO_HOME/config.yaml (default: ~/.config/ipgeo/config.yaml). VS Code and yaml-language-server users: add '# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kibaamor/ipgeo/main/cmd/ipgeo/doc/config.schema.json' to the top of your config.yaml for full IntelliSense support.

sources.description: Ordered list of IP geolocation sources. Lookup queries sources in order and returns the first successful result.

HTTPConfig.title: HTTP Config
HTTPConfig.description: HTTP settings used when ensuring missing source files, running `ipgeo update`, and running `ipgeo upgrade`.

timeout.description: HTTP timeout for all requests, as a Go duration. Defaults to 30m when omitted.

retryWaitMin.description: Minimum wait time before first retry, as a Go duration. Defaults to 0s when omitted.

retryWaitMax.description: Maximum wait time between retries, as a Go duration. Defaults to 3s when omitted.

retryMax.description: Maximum number of retry attempts. Defaults to 1 when omitted. Set to 0 to disable retries.

SourceEntry.title: Source Entry
SourceEntry.description: Configuration for a single IP geolocation source.

type.description:
Source database type. Determines which parser opens and queries the file.

- xdb: ip2region v2 format (github.com/lionsoul2014/ip2region). Supports separate IPv4 and IPv6 files via companion_filename.
- mmdb: MaxMind DB format (github.com/oschwald/maxminddb-golang). Supports an optional companion mmdb for ASN data via companion_filename.
- ipdb: IPIP.net binary format (github.com/ipipdotnet/ipdb-go).
- ip2location: IP2Location BIN format (github.com/ip2location/ip2location-go/v9).

name.description: Human-readable name for this source. Must be unique across sources. Used by `--source` and status output. Inline lookup output renders the lookup result, for example `1.1.1.1  [Australia/New South Wales/Sydney,Cloudflare,13335]`.

filename.description: Local source filename resolved under IPGEO_HOME. Runtime validation rejects values whose resolved path is IPGEO_HOME itself or outside it. Must not conflict with any source filename or companion_filename. Existing files are reused on startup; `ipgeo update` refreshes them.

urls.description: Source download URLs tried in order when a file is missing or `ipgeo update` runs. The first HTTP 200 response is used. URLs ending in .gz are decompressed. {YEAR} and {MONTH} use the current UTC year/month.

companion_filename.description:
Local companion source filename resolved under IPGEO_HOME. Runtime validation rejects values whose resolved path is IPGEO_HOME itself or outside it. Must not conflict with any source filename or companion_filename.

Used by:
- xdb: IPv6 .xdb file.
- mmdb: companion ASN .mmdb file.

companion_urls.description:
Download URLs for the companion source file. Required when companion_filename is set.

Used by:
- xdb: IPv6 .xdb URLs.
- mmdb: companion ASN .mmdb URLs, queried with the main city database.

UpdaterConfig.title: Updater Config
UpdaterConfig.description: Settings for the CLI upgrade command ('ipgeo upgrade').

release_urls.description: GitHub Releases API URLs tried in order by `ipgeo upgrade`. The matching OS/architecture asset replaces the running binary. {YEAR} and {MONTH} are not supported.
